title: A save from before M7 keeps everything, and its river starts carrying timber
about: A raw v18 save from the M6 deploy, fall 10, the weir restored by play (valley.weirOn 1, place.weir 3) and no M7 stats: nothing is lost or given. No drift waits yet (the first logs come the next morning), no timber, the Marls' house boarded at 0 of 6, Senna not in the valley. Orin's sheet offers the timber hook (250g) and his letter about drift timber comes the next morning.
